authority.rule: The standalone pack submits one exact literal command to the host permission system and contributes no allow rule. The host may prompt, allow, or deny it. A separately installed overlay may impose a stricter stop before Bash.

cub_client.provenance_caveat: cub version and Go build metadata bind the advertised v0.2.15 commit and reviewed binary hash, but go version -m reports vcs.modified=true, the module version is (devel), signing is ad hoc, and no package-manager receipt or official release checksum was found. Treat installed help and exact local client source as command-shape evidence for this hash, not as official-release provenance.

unselected_profiles.reason: This tuple supplied earlier static server-source evidence. Its behavior cases remain history and are not projected onto the current v0.2.15/v0.2.21 runtime.
This older tuple is preserved only so compatibility history is not lost.

current_delivery_contract.effective_release_set: Units in the selected Space whose Unit.TargetID equals Space.ReleaseTargetID
current_delivery_contract.release_revision_default: Installed help says each effective Unit head
current_delivery_contract.release_revision_tagged: Installed v0.2.15 help says each effective Unit resolves to the highest Revision currently carrying the TagID and a Unit without that tag falls back to head. Tag membership is mutable; exact v0.2.21 provider implementation was not source-reviewed here.
current_delivery_contract.untagged_publish_side_effect: An earlier reviewed server profile created release-<ReleaseNum> and attached that TagID to bundled Revisions. Current v0.2.21 source is unavailable, so do not assert that side effect without observing the current result.
current_delivery_contract.scope_rule: Installed publish help exposes no Unit, Filter, ChangeSet, cross-Space, expected TargetID, expected tag mapping, or expected manifest selector. Re-present narrower intent as whole-Space scope before submission and describe the preview-to-execution race.

helm_contract.unit_granularity: one Unit per chart template file; CRD files are separate file-derived Units
helm_contract.values_compatibility_shape: independent <component>-<environment>-helm/base plus environment Variant using --space-pattern template:{{.Labels.Component}} per materially different values set

known_semantic_gaps.current_help_claim: A Unit with no matching tagged Revision falls back to its head Revision.
known_semantic_gaps.historical_source_observation: An older reviewed server profile returned an error instead.
known_semantic_gaps.current_policy: Use the installed-help command shape for ordinary requested publication, disclose the fallback claim, inspect the actual result, and do not claim source-proven selection semantics.

known_semantic_gaps.historical_observation: Version 0.4.0 incorrectly made an additional approval service a prerequisite for every standalone change.
known_semantic_gaps.current_policy: Standalone requested changes use the host permission system. No additional approval component is part of this pack; an optional external overlay owns any stricter policy it injects.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: A raw shell string is not a structured final argv boundary, so the plugin must not preapprove Bash.
known_semantic_gaps.current_policy: Keep allowed-tools empty and submit one literal scoped command to the host permission system. This limits automatic permission claims; it does not make standalone reads or requested changes unavailable.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: Installed v0.2.15 help advertises numeric, LiveRevisionNum, Tag, and ChangeSet selectors. Exact v0.2.21 server acceptance and atomic preconditions were not source-reviewed.
known_semantic_gaps.current_policy: Confirm the selector with installed help, submit an explicitly requested scoped approval normally, inspect the result, and do not describe it as exact reviewed-artifact compare-and-swap without provider evidence.

known_semantic_gaps.historical_observation: An older reviewed Unit update path could compare caller-supplied head and content fields transactionally, while convenience paths did not prove that reviewed values reached execution.
known_semantic_gaps.current_policy: A fresh pre-read reduces uncertainty but is not atomic. Ordinary requested updates may use the host permission flow; report only the command result and verified post-state, not exact preview-to-execution binding.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: Installed publish help exposes no expected target, tag mapping, ordered Unit/revision manifest, or proposal digest.
known_semantic_gaps.current_policy: Ordinary requested publication may proceed after whole-Space scope disclosure and a fresh pre-read. Do not claim that the preview was atomically bound to provider execution.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: Release.UnitCount and today's target members do not by themselves identify historical bundle membership.
known_semantic_gaps.current_policy: Retain a UnitID/RevisionID/RevisionNum/DataHash publication receipt when historical membership must be proven. A missing receipt is a proof gap, not proof that an ordinary publish command is unavailable.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: The public Release resource does not expose the historical target or stored manifest.
known_semantic_gaps.current_policy: Use a digest-matching publication or registry receipt for a historical target claim; otherwise name the target proof gap.

known_semantic_gaps.historical_observation: An older reviewed server profile checked DestroyGates against then-current target membership during withdrawal.
known_semantic_gaps.current_policy: Inventory the selected Release and current dependent Units before withdrawal, submit only the exact ReleaseID, and verify the result. Do not project the older provider behavior onto v0.2.21.

known_semantic_gaps.historical_observation: An older reviewed server profile hard-deleted a Release without withdrawal checks.
known_semantic_gaps.current_policy: For safety and retention, require the Release to be withdrawn and evidence retained before a separately requested delete. Current v0.2.21 gate enforcement is not source-proven; do not claim either bypass or enforcement.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: The former cub v0.2.10 / server v0.2.11 tuple is not the installed profile.
known_semantic_gaps.current_policy: Do not use its command behavior as current evidence.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: cub worker logs selects a local slug-named file, may scan the full file, and has no byte ceiling or credential redaction.
known_semantic_gaps.current_policy: Do not collect raw worker logs as trusted evidence. Ask for a bounded redacted excerpt or use a reviewed identity-bound reader when available.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: Raw Helm/Kustomize rendering can fetch mutable inputs, traverse symlinks, load plugins, execute extensions, or produce unbounded output.
known_semantic_gaps.current_policy: Stop only when the source is remote, unpinned, executable, escapes the bound root, or lacks required resource ceilings. A reviewed local source closure may proceed through the owning bounded workflow.

known_semantic_gaps.observation: Static checks do not prove that a controller consumed a particular OCI manifest digest or that runtime resources converged.
known_semantic_gaps.current_policy: Gather read-only controller and runtime evidence or name the omitted proof.

claim_boundary: Passing the local validators proves source structure, inventory, command-policy, and deterministic T0 fixtures for this profile. It does not prove model selection, host behavior, provider atomicity, release publication, controller convergence, or live runtime state.
